    - paragraph: "Measured and approximate intervals are kept apart and never averaged together: an interval between two calvings known only to the month can be off by about 60 days either way, more than the difference between a good interval and a bad one.   - region "Where the milk went":
    - heading "Where the milk went" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The last 30 days, 12 Oct – 10 Nov 2026
    - text: Measured 130 L from 22 records Sold 107.5 L Rs 20,262.50 Kept at home 16.5 L counted on its own, not in the gap Gap 6 L no percentage
    - paragraph: "No percentage, on purpose: 5 milkings were taken but not weighed and 2 animal-sessions have no row at all, so production is a lower bound and a percentage of it would be false in a direction nobody would guess."
    - paragraph: "Dispatch: 5 of 5 sessions had every regular buyer answered."
    - paragraph: "The gap is measured minus dispatched, and it mixes two unknowns that pull opposite ways: milk taken but never weighed makes it negative, and a sale nobody recorded makes it positive. A negative gap is normal while any milking is unweighed, and it is not an alert. Occasional buyers have no row when they take nothing, so this gap is the only place an unrecorded household sale shows. Read it with the counts beside it."
